name: Machadka Tahdiibul Adfaal MIS
description: System-ka Maamulka Dugsiga Qur'aanka iyo Waxbarashada ee Machadka Tahdiibul Adfaal (Tahdiibul Adfaal MIS) - Ardayda, Macallimiinta, Waalidiinta, Fasallada, Xifdinta Qur'aanka, Xaadiriska, Lacagaha, Imtixaannada iyo Warbixinnada. Qof kasta oo Play Store ka raadiya Tahdiibul Adfaal, Machadka Tahdiibul Adfaal, ama MIS wuxuu toos u helayaa app-kan rasmiga ah.
